name: unknown_test_v1
purpose: The FINAL, ONE-TIME independent evaluation set for the frozen candidate abstention rule chosen using calibration_v1 (max_sim < 0.60, see data/calibration_v1/calibration_v1.json:frozen_candidate_abstention_threshold). calibration_v1 chose the threshold; this set grades it. It must not be reused to re-tune or re-select a threshold -- if this evaluation is unsatisfactory, that is a finding to report, not a cue to adjust 0.60 and re-run against this same data (that would just make unknown_test_v1 a second calibration set).

category_definitions.known_holdout: The 50 trained species, research-grade, disjoint (image/observation/hash) from training, benchmark_v1, AND calibration_v1.
category_definitions.out_of_scope_ant: Formicidae species NOT among the 50 AND NOT among calibration_v1's 165 out-of-scope-ant species (excluded by taxon_id, 215 total) -- species-level disjointness, not just image-level. Tests whether the rule generalizes to a species it was never calibrated against, not just a new photo of one it was.
category_definitions.non_ant_insect: Non-Formicidae Insecta, research-grade, image/observation/hash disjoint from all three prior sets (species-level disjointness not enforced for this category -- only requested for out_of_scope_ant).
category_definitions.unrelated: Non-insect photos (Aves/Plantae/Mammalia), research-grade, same disjointness as non_ant_insect.

no_low_quality_known_category: unknown_test_v1 does not rebuild calibration_v1's low_quality_known category -- that category's purpose was exploring an ambiguous case during calibration (and it was never used as ground truth there either); it has no role in final grading.
exclusion_criteria: Structural: only observations created on/after 2026-06-16 eligible (same cutoff as benchmark_v1 and calibration_v1) -- training-disjointness guarantee.

Explicit exclusion against training's photo_id column (9989 ids), benchmark_v1's photo_id + observation_uuid columns (1591 each), and calibration_v1's photo_id + observation_uuid columns (1005 each) before any candidate was kept.
out_of_scope_ant additionally excluded calibration_v1's 165 out-of-scope-ant species by taxon_id (215 taxon_ids total, alongside the 50 known species).

Verified zero overlap after the fact on photo_id, observation_uuid, and sha256 against training, benchmark_v1, AND calibration_v1 (see verification block), plus the species-level check for out_of_scope_ant.

verification.note: Three rows were found and removed before this count, each a byte-identical re-upload under a different photo_id/observation_uuid (the same phenomenon found in benchmark_v1 and calibration_v1 -- hash-checking catches what ID-exclusion structurally cannot): (1) an internal duplicate within unknown_test_v1 itself (bindahara-moorei, kept the earlier upload); (2) a known_holdout candidate (leptomyrmex-erythrocephalus, photo_id 693315171) duplicating content already in benchmark_v1 under a different photo_id (691253248) -- this is the SAME underlying photo found and removed from calibration_v1 in an earlier session, resurfacing here because removing it from calibration_v1.csv also removed it from this session's exclusion set; (3) a known_holdout candidate (tetraponera-rufonigra, photo_id 687741251) duplicating content already in calibration_v1 (photo_id 687148127). In both (2) and (3) the already-frozen dataset (benchmark_v1, calibration_v1) was left untouched; only the new unknown_test_v1 row was dropped. Original scrape yielded 576 images; final unknown_test_v1 is 573.
